description: Source code for managing reverse index of pack files in a version control system, including functions for sorting, creating, loading, and verifying reverse index data structures, as well as handling multi-pack indexes.

classes.name: struct revindex_entry
classes.description: Represents an entry in the reverse index with offset and index number.

classes.name: struct revindex_header
classes.description: Header structure for reverse index files containing signature, version, and hash id.

classes.name: struct midx_pack_key
classes.description: Key structure used for sorting and searching objects within multi-pack indexes, including pack ID, offset, preferred pack, and reference to the multi-pack index.

methods.name: sort_revindex
methods.description: Performs a least-significant-digit radix sort on revindex entries based on their offset.

methods.name: create_pack_revindex
methods.description: Creates a reverse index for a pack file by reading its index data and sorting entries by offset.

methods.name: create_pack_revindex_in_memory
methods.description: Loads and creates the reverse index for a pack file in memory, with optional test environment termination.

methods.name: pack_revindex_filename
methods.description: Generates the filename for the reverse index file based on the pack filename.

methods.name: load_revindex_from_disk
methods.description: Loads reverse index data from disk, verifying signature, version, and hash id.

methods.name: load_pack_revindex_from_disk
methods.description: Loads the reverse index for a pack file from disk into memory.

methods.name: load_pack_revindex
methods.description: Loads the reverse index for a pack, either from disk or by creating in memory.

methods.name: verify_pack_revindex
methods.description: Verifies the integrity of the on-disk reverse index against its checksum and consistency with in-memory data.

methods.name: can_use_midx_ridx_chunk
methods.description: Checks if a multi-pack index has a valid reverse index chunk.

methods.name: load_midx_revindex
methods.description: Loads the reverse index for a multi-pack index, either from chunk or disk.

methods.name: close_midx_revindex
methods.description: Unmaps and clears the reverse index data for a multi-pack index.

methods.name: offset_to_pack_pos
methods.description: Finds the pack position corresponding to a given offset.

methods.name: pack_pos_to_index
methods.description: Converts a pack position to an index number.

methods.name: pack_pos_to_offset
methods.description: Converts a pack position to an offset.

methods.name: pack_pos_to_midx
methods.description: Converts a pack position to a multi-pack index position.

methods.name: midx_to_pack_pos
methods.description: Converts a multi-pack index position to a pack position.

methods.name: midx_pair_to_pack_pos
methods.description: Converts a pack ID and offset pair to a pack position within a multi-pack index.
